question: 고객이 전부 몇 명이에요?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS customers FROM customer;
note: Count customer rows, not invoices (412) or invoice lines (2240).

question: 미국 고객은 몇 명이에요?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS customers FROM customer WHERE country = 'USA';
note: '미국' is stored as 'USA' (not 'United States' or 'US').

question: 전체 매출 합계가 얼마예요?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(total) AS revenue FROM invoice;
note: Sum of invoice totals; the line-level sum (unit price x quantity) gives the same 2328.60.

question: 주문 한 건 금액 중에 제일 큰 게 얼마예요?
gold_sql: SELECT max(total) AS max_invoice_total FROM invoice;
note: Largest single invoice total (invoice 404), not the highest track price (1.99).

question: 주문 한 건당 평균 금액이 얼마예요?
gold_sql: SELECT round(avg(total), 2) AS avg_invoice_total FROM invoice;
note: Average over the 412 invoices (2328.60 / 412 = 5.652), not over invoice lines (about 1.04).

question: 등록된 아티스트는 모두 몇 팀이에요?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS artists FROM artist;
note: Count every artist row; 71 artists have no album, so counting only artists with albums gives 204.

question: 직원 중에 나이가 제일 많은 사람이 누구예요?
gold_sql: SELECT first_name || ' ' || last_name AS employee FROM employee WHERE birth_date = (SELECT min(birth_date) FROM employee);
note: Earliest birth date (1947-09-19); not the earliest hire (Jane Peacock) or the top of the org chart (Andrew Adams).

question: 소속 회사가 입력돼 있는 고객은 몇 명이에요?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS customers FROM customer WHERE company IS NOT NULL;
note: Company is NULL for the other 49 customers (no empty strings), so the filter is IS NOT NULL.

question: 2023년 매출이 얼마예요?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(total) AS revenue FROM invoice WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2024-01-01';
note: Invoice dates in this copy run 2021-01-01 to 2025-12-22; years remembered from other Chinook releases will miss.

question: 2022년 1월 매출 얼마였어요?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(total) AS revenue FROM invoice WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2022-02-01';
note: Month filter on the invoice date (7 invoices); every timestamp is at 00:00.

question: 브라질 고객들 구매 금액 합계가 얼마예요?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(i.total) AS revenue FROM invoice i JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'Brazil';
note: '브라질' is stored as 'Brazil'; filtering the invoice billing country instead gives the same 190.10.

question: 매출이 제일 많은 나라 3곳이랑 나라별 매출 알려주세요.
gold_sql: SELECT billing_country AS country, revenue FROM (SELECT billing_country, sum(total) AS revenue, rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(total) DESC) AS rnk FROM invoice GROUP BY billing_country) s WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY revenue DESC;
note: 4th is Brazil at 190.10, close to France but outside the cut; grouping by customer country gives the same totals.

question: 구매 금액이 제일 큰 고객 3명이 누구고 각각 얼마예요?
gold_sql: SELECT customer, spent FROM (SELECT c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS customer, sum(i.total) AS spent, rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(i.total) DESC) AS rnk FROM customer c JOIN invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name) s WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY spent DESC;
note: Rank by money, not by number of orders (58 of 59 customers have 7 invoices); 4th place is a tie at 45.62, outside the cut.

question: 직원별로 담당 고객이 몇 명씩이에요?
gold_sql: SELECT e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS employee, count(*) AS customers FROM employee e JOIN customer c ON c.support_rep_id = e.employee_id GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name ORDER BY customers DESC;
note: The link is the customer's support rep; the other five employees have no customers, so also listing them with 0 is fine.

question: Michael Mitchell 밑에서 일하는 직원은 누구예요?
gold_sql: SELECT e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS employee FROM employee e JOIN employee m ON m.employee_id = e.reports_to WHERE m.first_name = 'Michael' AND m.last_name = 'Mitchell' ORDER BY e.employee_id;
note: Self-join on the reports-to link; neither report has reports of their own, so direct and indirect readings agree.

question: 곡이 제일 많은 장르 3개랑 장르별 곡 수 알려주세요.
gold_sql: SELECT genre, tracks FROM (SELECT g.name AS genre, count(*) AS tracks, rank() OVER (ORDER BY count(*) DESC) AS rnk FROM track t JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id GROUP BY g.genre_id, g.name) s WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY tracks DESC;
note: Count tracks per genre; 4th is Alternative & Punk at 332. 'Rock' and 'Rock And Roll' are separate genres.

question: 앨범을 제일 많이 낸 아티스트는 누구고 몇 장이에요?
gold_sql: SELECT artist, albums FROM (SELECT ar.name AS artist, count(*) AS albums, rank() OVER (ORDER BY count(*) DESC) AS rnk FROM album al JOIN artist ar ON ar.artist_id = al.artist_id GROUP BY ar.artist_id, ar.name) s WHERE rnk = 1;
note: Count albums per artist; runner-up is Led Zeppelin with 14.

question: Rock 곡 중에 한 번도 안 팔린 곡은 몇 곡이에요?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS unsold_tracks FROM track t JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id WHERE g.name = 'Rock' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoice_line l WHERE l.track_id = t.track_id);
note: Anti-join against invoice lines; the genre must be exactly 'Rock' (LIKE '%Rock%' also pulls in 'Rock And Roll' and gives 558).

question: 영업 담당자별로 담당 고객 매출이 전체 매출의 몇 %인지 소수점 첫째 자리까지 알려주세요.
gold_sql: SELECT e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS employee, round(100.0 * sum(i.total) / (SELECT sum(total) FROM invoice), 1) AS revenue_share_pct FROM employee e JOIN customer c ON c.support_rep_id = e.employee_id JOIN invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name ORDER BY revenue_share_pct DESC;
note: Sales reach an employee only through the customer's support rep; shares add to 100.0 and none sits on a rounding edge (35.77, 33.30, 30.93).

question: 매출이 제일 높은 아티스트 3팀이랑 각각 매출액 알려주세요.
gold_sql: SELECT artist, revenue FROM (SELECT ar.name AS artist, sum(l.unit_price * l.quantity) AS revenue, rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(l.unit_price * l.quantity) DESC) AS rnk FROM invoice_line l JOIN track t ON t.track_id = l.track_id JOIN album al ON al.album_id = t.album_id JOIN artist ar ON ar.artist_id = al.artist_id GROUP BY ar.artist_id, ar.name) s WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY revenue DESC;
note: Revenue has to come from invoice lines through track and album to artist (an invoice total mixes artists); 4th is Led Zeppelin at 86.13.

question: 제일 많이 팔린 장르 3개에서 장르별 판매 수량 1위 아티스트랑 그 수량 알려주세요.
gold_sql: WITH genre_units AS (SELECT t.genre_id, sum(l.quantity) AS units, rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(l.quantity) DESC) AS grnk FROM invoice_line l JOIN track t ON t.track_id = l.track_id GROUP BY t.genre_id), artist_units AS (SELECT t.genre_id, ar.name AS artist, sum(l.quantity) AS units, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY t.genre_id ORDER BY sum(l.quantity) DESC) AS arnk FROM invoice_line l JOIN track t ON t.track_id = l.track_id JOIN album al ON al.album_id = t.album_id JOIN artist ar ON ar.artist_id = al.artist_id GROUP BY t.genre_id, ar.artist_id, ar.name) SELECT g.name AS genre, a.artist, a.units FROM genre_units gu JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = gu.genre_id JOIN artist_units a ON a.genre_id = gu.genre_id AND a.arnk = 1 WHERE gu.grnk <= 3 ORDER BY gu.units DESC;
note: Rank inside each genre by the track's genre: Iron Maiden leads overall but is 3rd in Rock and 2nd in Metal; ranking by revenue picks the same genres and artists.

question: 고객이 제일 많은 나라 5곳에서 나라마다 구매 금액 1위 고객이 누구예요?
gold_sql: WITH country_rank AS (SELECT country, count(*) AS customers, rank() OVER (ORDER BY count(*) DESC) AS crnk FROM customer GROUP BY country), spend AS (SELECT c.country, c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS customer, sum(i.total) AS spent, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY c.country ORDER BY sum(i.total) DESC) AS srnk FROM customer c JOIN invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.country, c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name) SELECT s.country, s.customer FROM spend s JOIN country_rank cr ON cr.country = s.country WHERE cr.crnk <= 5 AND s.srnk = 1 ORDER BY cr.customers DESC, s.country;
note: Top 5 by customer count is USA 13, Canada 8, Brazil 5, France 5, Germany 4 (6th: United Kingdom 3); names keep their accents as stored.

question: 연도별 매출 1위 영업 담당자가 누구고, 그해 담당 고객 매출이 얼마였어요?
gold_sql: WITH yearly AS (SELECT extract(year FROM i.invoice_date)::int AS yr, e.employee_id, e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS rep, sum(i.total) AS revenue FROM invoice i JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = c.support_rep_id GROUP BY 1, e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name), ranked AS (SELECT yr, rep, revenue, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY yr ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rnk FROM yearly) SELECT yr, rep, revenue FROM ranked WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY yr;
note: Year of the invoice date, revenue via the customer's support rep; the all-time leader Jane Peacock tops only 2022 and 2023; closest year is 2021 (164.34 vs 161.37).

question: Grunge 재생목록에 곡이 제일 많이 들어간 아티스트는 누구고 몇 곡이에요?
gold_sql: SELECT artist, tracks FROM (SELECT ar.name AS artist, count(*) AS tracks, rank() OVER (ORDER BY count(*) DESC) AS rnk FROM playlist p JOIN playlist_track pt ON pt.playlist_id = p.playlist_id JOIN track t ON t.track_id = pt.track_id JOIN album al ON al.album_id = t.album_id JOIN artist ar ON ar.artist_id = al.artist_id WHERE p.name = 'Grunge' GROUP BY ar.artist_id, ar.name) s WHERE rnk = 1;
note: 'Grunge' is a playlist, not a genre (no genre has that name); runner-up is Pearl Jam with 4.
